answer: PoA resists Sybil identities by requiring continuous verification through a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings whose output is checked with a compact proof. Because each square depends on the previous result, an attacker cannot divide one clone’s computation across GPUs; simulating many clones multiplies the physical delay, regardless of whether their labels are ferrous, crystal, or island, limiting the forgery rate.
